title: Our power is shut off (SCE safety shutoff)
text:
⚡ Our power is shut off — SCE safety shutoff (Orion circuit)
SCE has shut off our circuit to prevent wildfires. Power comes back after the wind dies down and crews inspect the lines. SCE’s estimate at 12:42 PM: back by Sat, Oct 17, 5 AM.
Keep the fridge closed: it stays cold about 4 hours, a full freezer about 2 days. Downed line? Stay away and call 911.
SCE status: sce.com/outagemap
Live info: https://tesorohighlands.com/fire
